## GTA 6 Infamous Leaker CyberLeek Returns With 25-Minute Footage

It appears that the infamous GTA 6 leaker known as 'CyberLeek' is back in action. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the notorious leaker has published a massive 25-minute video featuring unreleased footage from Rockstar Games' highly anticipated title. 

### X-Rated Scenes and Dev Menu Spotted

The newly surfaced video, which Eurogamer has reviewed and believes to be legitimate, takes things to an entirely new level. It includes explicit and nude scenes featuring fully naked Jason and a topless Lucia. Beyond the controversial character models, the footage also showcases dynamic gameplay elements such as dirt-biking and a developer menu (dev menu), offering a rare glimpse into the game's internal testing phases.

### The Trademark Emblem

True to the leaker's established tradition, the newly leaked footage features 'CyberLeek's' distinct emblem overlaid directly on top of the video content. While Rockstar Games maintains strict security measures and has historically cracked down on leaks, this latest 25-minute drop has quickly circulated across various gaming communities and social platforms, sparking intense discussions among fans worldwide.

### Editor's Take

While leaks undeniably feed the insatiable appetite of eager fans, they disrupt the developers' carefully planned rollout. We strongly advise the community to approach unauthorized leaks with caution and wait for official updates directly from Rockstar Games.
